About SFD One Directory

San Fernando District OneDirectory (SFD OneDirectory) is an innovation project of the District ISM under the SFD OnePortal Innovation of the District ICT. It centralizes frequently used DepEd portals, district services, and digital applications in one accessible place.

App Changelog

Development milestones from the first directory build to the PWA release. Early beta entries describe feature milestones; exact dates are not assigned.

Version 1.0 — PWA Release

Introduces installable app support, offline caching of the directory shell, light/dark mode, Tools and Applications, About, and this changelog.

Beta 0.9.5 — PIRPA Portal

Added the School PIRPA Portal with a brown theme and checklist icon.

Beta 0.9.0 — District Favicon

Embedded the San Fernando District logo as the browser favicon.

Beta 0.8.0 — DCP Portal

Added the DCP Monitoring and Inventory Portal with its own red theme and computer icon.

Beta 0.7.0 — Service Identity

Added service-specific visual treatments for PROServ and SBFP Daily Monitoring.

Beta 0.6.0 — District and Learning Links

Added national and regional resources, district links, and the Schools section placeholder.

Beta 0.5.0 — Division Portals

Expanded the SDO Level with division services and custom portal icons and color themes.

Beta 0.4.0 — Search and Navigation

Added directory search and quick navigation between categories.

Beta 0.3.0 — Visual Refresh

Introduced the bright yellow and white-gray visual theme, responsive cards, and district branding.

Beta 0.2.0 — Category Organization

Organized links into SDO, National, Regional, District, and Schools sections.

Beta 0.1.0 — Initial Directory

Created the first centralized directory for commonly used DepEd and district websites.
